answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in saffron-denominated escrow before joining the market, with slashing on proven duplicate identities. A new identity must also complete a verifiable work proof, like solving a unique marble puzzle tied to a relic credential issued after real-world attestation. Creating a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand proofs, while an honest single agent pays once. Sybil farming stops being cheap and becomes a losing trade.
